source_comparison.definition: Current manuscripts listed as accompanying papers in a family's Lean scope note (lean/docs/NNN.md) that links at least one Comparator statement.

reported_receipts.rule: Current manuscripts named as accompanying papers in a scope note that links a challenge file. This is an association by the note; it does not say which of a paper's claims the Lean states.

reconstruction: Concatenate each named collection in page order and restore it on number. The logical receipt digest binds the complete record; page hashes alone do not establish the aggregate.
